comment: The taraf strum jack is configured as "Taraf string tuning" at Raga.cpp:240 but is read at line 666 as a trigger that strums the tarafs; the panel prints TARAF STRUM over it and the code agrees with the panel. The three tuning knobs are configured 1 to 11 (lines 254-260) against note tables holding twelve entries, so the last name in each table, B on the main knob and Ni on the second and third, cannot be selected. The module declares a right-hand audio output in its OutputId enum but adds no jack for it, so the instrument is mono and the second output can never be reached. GLIDETYPE_PARAM is configured at line 252 and read at line 649 but has no widget, so its linear-or-logarithmic choice is fixed at the default and cannot be changed from the panel. The fader sums at lines 633-638 clamp the knob and the CV separately but not the total, so a level above one is reachable.
